title: Defined Terms: When an Insurance Binder's Cover Is Counted From on a Wayfare Agreement
content:
These defined terms of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product fix the day from which a recorded insurance binder's cover is counted, and so the binder acceptance days: the calendar days from the recording day for which the binder is accepted as the auto insurance on file.

### Terms

- **Recording day:** the day support records the binder.
- **Upload date:** the date of the binder's upload entry, the binder being the latest auto insurance upload on the standing record.
- **Insurance on the agreement:** the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement as it stands on the recording day.

### Takeover-clock rule

- When the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement is later than the recording day, the binder takes over when that insurance ends, so its cover is counted from that expiry date: the days from the recording day to that expiry date are added to the binder acceptance days.
- When the insurance on the agreement had already expired before the binder's upload date, the binder's cover is counted from its upload date, so the days the binder waited to be recorded are used up: the days from the upload date to the recording day are taken off the binder acceptance days.
- When the insurance expired on or after the upload date and no later than the recording day, the cover is counted from the recording day, and nothing is added or taken off.

### Worked cases (hypothetical: upload date 2026-06-20, recording day 2026-07-01)

| Auto insurance expiry date on the agreement | Cover counted from | Days added (taken off) |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-12 | 2026-07-12 | 11 added |
| 2026-07-01 | 2026-07-01 | none |
| 2026-06-25 | 2026-07-01 | none |
| 2026-06-20 | 2026-07-01 | none |
| 2026-06-10 | 2026-06-20 | 11 taken off |
